name: Clickpad
long_description:
ClickPad.com (fka WeReno) is an AI-powered back office that helps contractors take on more projects without hiring administrative staff or learning complicated software.

After 10+ years in construction and facilitating over $1B in renovations through WeReno, we've packaged everything we've learned about running a successful contracting business into an AI employee that fits in the palm of your hand.

Contractors simply text, call, or WhatsApp Click in any of 13 supported languages. Click handles leads, estimates, contracts, invoices, payments, scheduling, change orders, and client communication. We also generate AI-powered contractor websites with 24/7 lead capture.

We discovered that 95% of our trade partners had no website or CRM. Rather than build another dashboard, we built an AI agent that actually runs their back office through simple conversations.

Our mission is simple: give millions of contractors the tools and expertise of a fully staffed back office, right in the palm of their hand, so they can run bigger businesses without bigger teams.
one_liner: The AI employee for contractors. No software to learn. Just text.
